origin.title: GitHub Trending Weekly #56
origin.verification_note: Video auto captions and publisher description used only for discovery; project claims independently cross-checked against repository README/license paths. No candidate was installed, built, or benchmarked.

scope: This is a SUPPLEMENTAL graph. It does not modify semantic-graph.v1.json counts or mark external candidates integrated. These nodes join via the referenced existing target IDs.

nodes.label: Floorplan
nodes.description: Local interactive codebase topology: files, imports, request-to-endpoint matching across repos, plain-English views and health review.
constraints: Node 18+, local Claude Code/Codex workflow; scan does not replace independent evidence verification
README's deeper language-support list omits Swift; Nerd Court Swift semantics must be independently tested
Generated map remains local and uncommitted; versioned semantic and source graphs in this repository remain the authority
nodes.test_gate: On a workspace containing pinned UATU, Grizzly Knights, and advanced Nerd Court, identify exact Swift->Convex boundary plus Python UATU paths; compare against manually confirmed call edges.

nodes.label: Kinetograph
nodes.description: Programmatic TypeScript/Remotion-compatible composition with Rust GPU compositor, audio, FFmpeg video output and agent-facing QA commands.
constraints: Upstream README explicitly calls v0.2.5 beta and notes incomplete API/features
PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0 with eligibility, revenue and distribution conditions; commercial review before adoption
Rendering demonstrations on short scenes do not establish 15-30 minute throughput or consistent character animation
Swift SpriteKit court has no proven direct adapter; requires an intermediate versioned storyboard/scene contract
nodes.test_gate: Produce 30-90 seconds of original Court-like test footage from a stable CastManifest/shot list; check repeatability, long-scene memory, timing, audio mixing and MP4 decode on target hardware.

nodes.label: Pika H3 Flex
nodes.description: Reference-guided 5-15 second image/video/audio output with synchronized sound, potentially a shot-generation provider.
nodes.license: Code: Apache-2.0; model: MiniMax H3 Community License with territorial exclusions
constraints: Model adapters distributed under MiniMax H3 Community License, which excludes United States, EU, UK, Republic of Korea
Apache-2.0 applies to code, not the model weights/adapters; hosted Pika API has separate terms to review
Local tested requests primarily require H100 80GB, 66-69GiB GPU for 480p/5s; >211GB base components
Clip identity consistency, rights and camera continuity across many shots not demonstrated
nodes.test_gate: Do not deploy model in excluded territories without a separate, validated license. Only after license clearance, test cross-shot identity fidelity and cost.

nodes.label: Video to Game
nodes.description: Reverse-engineers a reference video into palettes, shots, assets and a Three.js interactive world; suggests video-as-design-spec for consistent court visuals.
nodes.license: MIT repository source; model/asset rights are separate
constraints: It makes playable games, not finished episodes
Reference workflow uses external fal asset/image-to-3D providers and budgets; generated asset rights and cost must be verified
Preserve existing Nerd Court storyboard/visual intent rather than adopting video-to-game's sample-game defaults
nodes.test_gate: Test one short original courtroom camera/character reference for reproducible assets, no production adoption until budget/rights reviewed.

nodes.label: Filmimic
nodes.description: Unreal Engine 5 post-process film looks, grain, bloom, halation and color treatment.
constraints: Upstream tested baseline is Unreal Engine 5.8.3 Windows DX12 SM6, not our existing Swift renderer
GPL-2.0-or-later with separate Unreal licensing, no compatibility exception
Cooked game and Unreal Movie Render Queue path not verified upstream
nodes.test_gate: Do not introduce UE5 into core architecture for a finishing filter; revisit only after render backend decision and counsel license review.

nodes.label: Lever
nodes.description: GitHub Copilot skill/plugin for metric-based engineering feedback loops, PR reviews, changes and bounded autonomy.
constraints: Developer workflow, not an on-demand television runtime
Specific GitHub Copilot integration and automation permissions must be reviewed
Existing red-green-refactor and evidence gates already supply some of this methodology
nodes.test_gate: Compare proposed measurable acceptance contracts against existing CI and graph gates before adding dependency.

nodes.label: ub-mode
nodes.description: TDD and deterministic engineering-quality skill concepts: complexity, duplication, mutation testing and task-scoped changes.
nodes.license: Not confirmed for root skill; review before copying
constraints: External agent skill; no stand-alone LICENSE file in source root in reviewed tree
Companion tools require separate installation, suitability and license checks
Metrics alone do not prove runtime character authenticity or video production quality
nodes.test_gate: Use behavioral tests/mutation on first isolated resolver component; adopt only with confirmed licensing and lower cost.

nodes.label: SoMark OXR
nodes.description: Document parsing with bounding boxes and Markdown/JSON output, candidate for interpreting complicated comic layouts or evidence scans.
nodes.license: OXR Open Source License (custom Apache-based restrictions)
constraints: Vendor-defined custom Apache-based license with funding/revenue restrictions and online attribution rules
Local documented path requires NVIDIA CUDA, at least 24GB GPU for low-concurrency use
Accuracy and benchmark leadership are vendor claims not independently validated here
nodes.test_gate: Run gold-set comics/PDF panel extraction and citation alignment; measure misses, frame-order errors and legal/license restrictions.

nodes.label: Strata
nodes.description: Local model serving and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible routing; optional development inference backend.
nodes.license: MIT (README claimed; inspect LICENSE on adoption)
constraints: Supported hardware list includes modern NVIDIA, AMD RX 6000-9000 (subset), Intel Arc, Apple Silicon; not generic all-AMD compatibility
Model performance and memory constraints need hardware-specific benchmarks
Does not solve media rendering, evidence provenance or human cast fidelity on its own
nodes.test_gate: Only if local inference is needed, benchmark actual intended machines/models against remote baseline.
